purpose: Observable plan for entitlements, provider receipts, quota boundaries, offline expiry and reconciliation while T14/T18/T19 are unaccepted; not implementation or behavior evidence.

dependencyGate.rule: Only independent synthetic fixture/interface planning is allowed before all direct dependencies are accepted.
dependencyGate.dependencyFrontierNote: Recursive prerequisite closure remains with canonical progress entries; this plan does not assert that the direct dependency list is the full transitive closure.

sources.currentCodeObservation: No apps/server billing/usage module or server workspace was present in the inspected v2 tree. No production, contract, shared fixture, script, lockfile, or progress file is changed.
sources.interpretation: Candidate values are not grants. Provider, database/RLS, device, offline-cache, retention, merchant and release checks stay independent.

allowlist.note: Only the two T26 plan/evidence files are written; no implementation, shared fixture, progress, manifest, lockfile, service, or live provider state is changed.

syntheticBoundary.data: Synthetic account/workspace/device/contract/event/price IDs, timestamps, byte counters and receipts only; no customer data, credentials, transaction payloads or secrets.
syntheticBoundary.provider: No Stripe, RevenueCat, App Store, Google Play, sandbox, staging, merchant or provider API was contacted.
syntheticBoundary.storage: No PostgreSQL, S3, worker, RLS role, live profile, customer ledger or cloud object was accessed.
syntheticBoundary.execution: No test, build, service, purchase, restore, refund or reconciliation behavior was run.

subtaskPlan.scope: Unique server-owned candidate configuration and trusted projection.
Channel receipts, trusted contract state, restore/refund, idempotency and reconciliation.
Downgrade, quota, pull/delete/export retention, offline expiry and permission/error edges.

candidateConfiguration.assertionBoundary: Check uniqueness and provenance only; proposals do not grant trial, entitlement, price, or capacity before policy approval.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Candidate-only config: Trial 14 days / 1 GiB / 3 devices / 7 history days; Personal Pro 10 GiB / 10 devices. Trial grant disabled pending explicit server policy.
fixtures.plannedAction: Inspect config ownership across server and clients and compare projected limits.
observableAssertions: One canonical server-owned source holds candidate duration/device values; client constants cannot grant or alter rights.
Values match 07 proposals and limits.v1 candidates but remain unapproved and grant no trial or capacity.
No price or entitlement is inferred from a plan label.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Fresh synthetic account; cloud default disabled; no verified contract or explicit server-issued trial. Client submits isPro=true, planCode=pro and forged cloudBytes/maxDevices.
fixtures.plannedAction: Read entitlement and attempt positive-delta cloud write.
observableAssertions: Login/client assertions alone do not grant cloud capacity; authorization uses trusted account projection.
No unauthorized write or ledger delta occurs; exact ignore/reject response is OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Synthetic server DTO cases for trial/active/grace/expired/revoked with documented fields version, accountId, status, features, cloudBytes, maxDevices, historyDays, validUntil, graceUntil, sourceChannels.
fixtures.plannedAction: Inspect serialized projection and state/account provenance.
observableAssertions: Only documented status values/DTO fields are represented and projection is account-scoped.
Frontend isPro is not authorization; state timing and grace privileges stay gated.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Account has two separately verified channel contracts with overlapping and distinct features/limits.
fixtures.plannedAction: Record one projection and per-contract provenance without applying an unfrozen merge algorithm.
observableAssertions: Projection identifies verified sourceChannels; unverified client claims contribute nothing.
Cross-channel union/max/precedence and duplicate-capacity treatment remain OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Synthetic webhook claims active but raw-body signature is invalid.
fixtures.plannedAction: Verify original raw bytes and headers; inspect receipt/job/projection counters.
observableAssertions: Invalid signature yields no trusted receipt, projection, or grant; raw body is not reserialized before verification.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Synthetic provider event is replayed exactly, reused under another provider namespace, and reused with changed bytes under the same provider/eventID.
fixtures.plannedAction: Inspect receipt, projection job, grant and capacity counters for each variant.
observableAssertions: Exact same provider/eventID replay applies once; event and projection-job persistence are transactional and provider fetch is outside locks.
Equal eventID strings from distinct providers do not collide.
Changed-body same-ID response is OPEN_QUESTION and cannot cause a second side effect.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Provider-current contract state is newer than a delayed webhook; a separate fetch variant returns timeout.
fixtures.plannedAction: Deliver events out of order and compare provider-current fetch with final projection.
observableAssertions: The projection decision is not labeled as provider-verified current contract state unless supported by a verified current-contract source.
Whether a failed provider fetch preserves, suspends, queues, or expires any prior projection, and the terminal response mapping, remain OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Validly signed webhook has unknown event type or productCode/price mapping.
fixtures.plannedAction: Route through planned quarantine/review; inspect entitlement and capacity.
observableAssertions: Unknown event/product is isolated for review and grants no entitlement or capacity.
Client cannot select price/product by label.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Sandbox fixture maps environment priceId to productCode and verified provider contract bound to account A.
fixtures.plannedAction: Complete planned purchase then read trusted projection.
observableAssertions: Only verified contract mapped to A can produce A's projection; client displayPrice does not grant features.
Money is integer minor units plus currency; sandbox does not prove live purchase readiness.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Restore request is authenticated as A and provider app-user/contract binding resolves to A.
fixtures.plannedAction: Restore twice and compare contract/receipt/projection counts.
observableAssertions: Restored contract resolves to correct internal account; body accountId is not ownership evidence.
Repeat restore creates no duplicate contract, event application, or capacity grant.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: A requests restore of a provider contract already bound to B.
fixtures.plannedAction: Attempt restore without modifying either account binding.
observableAssertions: No silent reassignment or B entitlement disclosure to A; conflict follows support path.
Exact conflict API mapping/workflow stays OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: A has verified active entitlement on channel 1 and opens purchase/restore on channel 2.
fixtures.plannedAction: Inspect existing-subscription presentation, checkout calls and contract state.
observableAssertions: Existing cross-channel entitlement is surfaced before duplicate purchase; system does not auto-cancel or mutate other channel.
Aggregate capacity rule remains OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Two verified channel contracts exist; only channel 1 receives provider-confirmed refund/revocation.
fixtures.plannedAction: Project refund and inspect both contract states and account capacity.
observableAssertions: Refund affects only its own contract; unrelated channel contract is not canceled or modified.
Aggregate result follows frozen cross-channel policy when decided; no capacity delta is double-applied.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Provider snapshots model partial refund, reversal, chargeback and renewal-after-refund separately.
fixtures.plannedAction: Capture verified state without choosing a provider-specific interpretation.
observableAssertions: No assertion invents partial-refund/proration/reversal semantics; unresolved variants remain OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Verified contract projects grace with validUntil/graceUntil; operations tagged read, pull, upload, device-add, delete, export; separate time points before/at/after expiry.
fixtures.plannedAction: Capture status and decisions at each boundary.
observableAssertions: Projection carries verified provenance and documented graceUntil.
Grace duration/permissions, time equality, clock source and expiry retention/deletion remain OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Provider-current contract is revoked/expired while an older active event arrives afterward.
fixtures.plannedAction: Attempt positive-delta upload/device-add after provider-current verification.
observableAssertions: Stale active event cannot reinstate expired/revoked contract; absent another entitlement it grants no new cloud capacity.
Any other valid contract remains unaffected; cross-channel result is gated.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Synthetic account is over effective quota with existing cloud data and a local copy.
fixtures.plannedAction: Attempt positive-delta upload/new restricted device, then pull/read, explicit delete, export and local access.
observableAssertions: Over-limit positive-delta upload and new restricted device are blocked.
Pull/read, explicit delete, export, and existing local access remain available; favorites/data are not silently deleted.
Rejected write has no partial mutation/positive ledger delta.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Downgrade/refund/expiry leaves history, favorite, trash, versions and offline local content.
fixtures.plannedAction: Advance status and inspect references/export/delete options without issuing deletion.
observableAssertions: Downgrade alone does not silently remove favorites or user data.
Automatic cloud purge is not assumed; deletion/retention deadline remains OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Explicit delete is accepted while over quota; provider deletion has controllable confirmation/failure barrier.
fixtures.plannedAction: Inspect usage ledger before and after provider confirmation.
observableAssertions: Delete remains available during downgrade.
Bytes/object use is not released before required physical deletion is confirmed; failed/unknown delete retains occupancy.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Usage inventory includes versions, trash, pins, pending reservations and physically retained objects after limits are lowered.
fixtures.plannedAction: Request a new version and compare counters/references.
observableAssertions: Existing retained/pending bytes are not silently free or deleted; full legitimate version budget blocks another version with a handling path.
Charge categories and capacity boundary await T18 acceptance.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Server-derived maxDevices is reached; extra device is pending and client submits higher forged maxDevices.
fixtures.plannedAction: Attempt activation/download, then a local-only action.
observableAssertions: Device limit derives from trusted projection; pending device has no cloud download before T14 authorization.
Existing local access stays available; exact error mapping remains OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Previously valid signed entitlement cache is tested offline just before and after validUntil.
fixtures.plannedAction: Attempt local read/search and separately cloud authorization.
observableAssertions: Cache may be displayed while valid; after expiry client cannot claim cloud permission remains valid.
Local functionality remains available; clock tolerance and refresh UX are OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Offline cache has altered signature, unknown key or clock rollback/advance across validUntil.
fixtures.plannedAction: Attempt validation in a disposable fixture.
observableAssertions: Unverified cache cannot authorize cloud operations.
Signature/key rotation/time policy and exact errors remain OPEN_QUESTION; no crypto format is invented.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Workspaces A/B have separate principals/contracts/ledgers; A submits B scope then a valid A request on the same pooled connection.
fixtures.plannedAction: Inspect protected reads/writes, projection, ledger and scope isolation.
observableAssertions: No B billing/receipt/projection/quota is disclosed or mutated; subsequent A scope does not leak.
No owner/service-role bypass; RLS evidence waits for T14.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Checkout session is canceled before any verified provider contract exists.
fixtures.plannedAction: Return through callback and inspect projection, contract and usage.
observableAssertions: Cancel is not purchase success and grants no entitlement absent a verified contract.
Exact callback/session result is OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Provider accepted one checkout idempotency key but client timed out before response.
fixtures.plannedAction: Retry with same key and reconcile existing session/contract before another attempt.
observableAssertions: Unknown result does not trigger a second checkout/charge; preserve same operation identity.
Key retention and exact response remain OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Over-capacity and permission-denied requests have before/after row, receipt, reservation, byte and ledger snapshots.
fixtures.plannedAction: Exercise positive-delta and unauthorized operations.
observableAssertions: The observable result does not authorize the specified over-limit positive-delta operation or permission-denied action.
Receipt/reservation creation, rollback/partial-write effects, exact error code/fields, and retryability are OPEN_QUESTION; record observed values later without asserting zero receipt or zero rows.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Provider-current state changes while webhook is dropped; reconciliation uses fixed account scope/watermark.
fixtures.plannedAction: Fetch/project and record receipt, projection version, provenance and capacity delta.
observableAssertions: Reconciliation repairs from current contract without the lost webhook; fetch is outside DB lock and job/projection receipt commits idempotently.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Replay same reconciliation job/provider state; separate attempt has provider unavailable with prior verified projection.
fixtures.plannedAction: Compare event/receipt/projection/ledger counts and retry state.
observableAssertions: Replay does not double-grant entitlement or ledger delta.
Unavailable provider creates no unverified grant; stale projection policy/cadence/backoff remain OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Environment-scoped priceId→productCode map and channel flags contain no merchant credentials or selected public entry.
fixtures.plannedAction: Inspect checkout mapping source and release readiness references.
observableAssertions: Client does not infer price/product; unselected merchant/store channels remain disabled.
B11 needs separate merchant eligibility and T31 region/platform policy; fixture cannot pass it.

fixtures.syntheticSetup: Synthetic redaction canaries: unique sentinels stand in for body, URL, title, source, image, key, token, and SQL parameters across webhook/checkout/quota/reconciliation error and crash paths.
fixtures.plannedAction: Collect only synthetic telemetry/log/crash/error-packet outputs after planned error and crash-boundary cases; scan artifacts for every sentinel and raw provider/error payload.
observableAssertions: No synthetic body, URL, title, source, image, key, token, or unsanitized SQL parameter canary appears in telemetry, crash output, or error packets.
Allowed operational event fields are limited to counts, type, duration, and error code; the canary proves only the isolated synthetic path when later run.

gates.requiredEvidence: T14 accepted plus isolated scoped-role evidence; no cross-account access.
T18 accepted plus reservation/pending/deleting accounting and physical-delete confirmation.
Isolated test-mode webhook/checkout/portal/restore/refund evidence; no live customers or credentials.
Separate RevenueCat/App Store sandbox result on supported iOS development device.
Separate RevenueCat/Google Play sandbox result on supported Android development device.
Isolated provider polling/worker evidence for lost events and idempotent retry.
Separate Web/desktop/iOS/Android expiry/signature evidence after time/key contract freezes.
T00 merchant eligibility plus T31 selected region/platform/store entry/release policy.
Provider refunds T26-T28 and export/delete/rollout T29/T30 plus T31 review; plan does not pass G4.

gates.boundary: Independent real isolated PostgreSQL transaction/receipt/ledger/worker gate
gates.requiredEvidence: After prerequisite acceptance, use disposable isolated PostgreSQL and app/worker roles with synthetic fixed inputs and transaction barriers to check F006 receipt plus projection-job atomicity, F028 projection/ledger commit, and F029 replay idempotency. No real provider is called.
gates.separation: Database/worker persistence gate only; separate from Stripe/App Store/Google Play provider gates T26-G04 through T26-G07.

plannedCommands.availabilityObservation: Static inspection found no apps/server workspace and root package.json has no server test script; not executed, T01/T06 infrastructure prerequisite.
Static inspection found no root test:integration script; not executed, T01/T06 infrastructure prerequisite.

openQuestions.topic: Trial eligibility/abuse policy, grant start instant and final approval of candidate values are not frozen.
openQuestions.handling: Candidate values do not grant a trial; resolve before issuance.

openQuestions.topic: Cross-channel aggregation of features/bytes/devices/history and duplicate same-product contracts is unspecified.
Grace duration/permissions, expiry equality and cloud retention/deletion deadlines are not frozen.
openQuestions.handling: Do not infer grace access or automatic purge.

openQuestions.topic: Signed-cache format, key rotation, trusted clock, skew/rollback and revocation refresh are undefined.
openQuestions.handling: No crypto protocol or client shortcut is invented.

openQuestions.topic: Partial refund, reversal, chargeback and renewal-after-refund mapping are unspecified.
Checkout cancellation/timeout result, idempotency retention, callback replay and expiry policy are undefined.
openQuestions.handling: Unknown outcome keeps same operation identity; no exact response assumed.

openQuestions.topic: Changed-body eventID reuse, signature-key rotation, timestamps, provider-current fetch failure and its terminal mapping need definition.
openQuestions.handling: Do not derive a provider-current contract from an unverified source; whether a failed fetch preserves/suspends/queues/expires prior projection remains open.

openQuestions.topic: Restore conflict/support mapping and accepted T14 identity/device/RLS contract are unavailable.
openQuestions.handling: Client accountId is never ownership proof.

openQuestions.topic: Quota formula and reservation/cipher/trash/version/pin/unknown-delete categories depend on T18.
openQuestions.handling: Candidate bytes do not define usage accounting.

openQuestions.topic: Exact capacity/device errors, positive-delta boundaries, rejected-operation receipt/reservation/rollback side effects, and reconciliation retry/stale policy are unspecified.
openQuestions.handling: Assert no unauthorized positive delta; do not mint codes or schedules.

openQuestions.topic: Product/price catalogue, merchant eligibility, region and store entry are not selected.
openQuestions.handling: No price/public purchase inferred from candidate package.

openQuestions.topic: Sandbox accounts, test harness/scripts and staging environment are not established.
openQuestions.handling: No service contacted; commands remain NOT_RUN.

releaseBoundary: 08 G4 is not passed. T26/T28 provider refund, T29/T30 export/delete/rollout and T31 aggregate release remain independent gates.
gateCoverageRule: requiredGateIds in each B01-B12 acceptance-map entry are explicit mandatory gates; the matching gate lists the same acceptance IDs in requiredForAcceptanceIds. Every relation is validated bidirectionally.
